<header class="research-hero">
  <h1>Some Studies of Language Model Weight Edits</h1>
  <p>I tested how weight edits affect predictions across languages and whether a correction learned for one fine-tune can help another.</p>
  <p class="research-dates">First published <time datetime="2026-10-14">14 October 2026</time> · Updated <time datetime="2026-11-18">18 November 2026</time></p>

<section class="research-story" aria-labelledby="selective-editing">
  <div class="research-story-copy">
    <h2 id="selective-editing">Selective language editing</h2>
    <p>Worsening a model’s German predictions also affected its Dutch. How much depended on the edit. Across three language pairs, changing one weight subcomponent did the least damage to the related language when the edits were calibrated to the same target loss increase on validation text. LoRA and full-matrix fine-tuning preserved English predictions better.</p>

<section class="research-story" aria-labelledby="repair-transfer">
  <div class="research-story-copy">
    <h2 id="repair-transfer">Repair transfer</h2>
    <p>An earlier repair helped restore Dutch predictions on two new fine-tunes from the same model and recipe, while preserving the intended change to German. Training the repair vectors recovered more than rescaling them along their original directions. With little data and few steps, the earlier repair gave training a head start. At the largest budget, training from scratch nearly caught up.</p>

<div class="research-notes">
  <section aria-labelledby="about-these-studies">
    <h2 id="about-these-studies">About these studies</h2>
    <p>The work presented here is my attempt to understand interpretability and model editing methods more deeply. By building on recent advances and trying to find something new, I also learn what others have done before me. For me, the best way to learn is through practice.</p>
    <p>Although these studies are written in the form of research papers, I’m not yet confident that I can call them rigorous scientific work. I’m sharing them in the hope that they may be useful to someone besides me.</p>
  </section>

    <p>Most of the text was also written with AI assistance and went through several rounds of careful editing. I hope attentive readers will forgive me for that.</p>
